arguments.value: HuCC cd_reset(void) supplies no explicit API arguments beyond the system trampoline selector in Y.

returns.value: HuCC exposes void and ignores any BIOS return value. Actual return registers/status UNKNOWN.

stack.value: HuCC system macro uses JSR call_bios; trampoline uses JSR candidate entry and RTS with balanced PHA/PLA around bank changes. This is caller source only; callee stack depth, balance and return behavior UNKNOWN.

mpr.value: HuCC caller maps bank 0 into MPR7 for the call and restores caller MPR7 afterward. Startup maps MPR0=$FF and MPR1=$F8. Actual callee mapping prerequisites and preservation UNKNOWN.

ram.value: Hu-Go HLE writes 1 to CPU address $222D as its disc-present marker. Actual BIOS RAM writes and range UNKNOWN.

errors.value: Hu-Go physical-drive initialization failure exits the host with code 4; this is not a BIOS error return. BIOS timeout/no-disc/error values UNKNOWN.

synchronization.value: Hu-Go HLE initializes physical media or fills image metadata before simulated RTS. BIOS completion, busy and IRQ requirements UNKNOWN.

name_observations.locator: System Card function equates, lines 468-552

name_observations.name: CD_READ
name_observations.locator: function selector defines, lines 30-133 (HLE selector, not executable entry proof)

arguments.value: HuCC callers prepare sector triple _cl:_ch:_dl (high:middle:low), destination _bx, and mode _dh. Mode 0: local bytes in _ax; mode 3: bank in _bl and sector count in _al; $FE: VRAM address _bx and bytes _ax; $FF: VRAM address _bx and sectors _al. Hu-Go additionally models mode 1 local sectors and modes 2..6 bank transfer. Base-sector interpretation and valid ranges UNKNOWN.

returns.value: HuCC copies presumed A status to X and treats nonzero as error; its unsigned-char result is adapted to Y:A. Hu-Go implemented read paths report A=0 on success. Complete BIOS return contract UNKNOWN.

clobbered.value: HuCC saves five bytes _bx through _dl across repeated reads. This indicates caller protection, not proof all five are clobbered. Exact A/X/Y/work-RAM clobber set UNKNOWN.

stack.value: HuCC system macro uses JSR call_bios; trampoline uses JSR candidate entry and RTS with balanced PHA/PLA around bank changes. This is caller source only; callee stack depth, balance and return behavior UNKNOWN.

mpr.value: HuCC bank-mode wrapper saves/restores MPR3 and comments that CD_READ corrupts it on CD error. Overlay loader also reports MPRn corruption on error. Local-data wrapper saves/restores MPR3/MPR4 for its own mapping; call_bios separately restores MPR7. Actual success/error callee MPR state UNKNOWN.

ram.value: HuCC equates define _al/_ah/_bl/_bh/_cl/_ch/_dl/_dh at bank $F8 CPU $20F8..$20FF, words _ax/_bx/_cx/_dx low byte first. Read destination RAM/VRAM writes are expected by callers; exact extent, work-RAM writes and base-table semantics UNKNOWN.

flags.value: Hu-Go HLE implemented read paths update N/Z for A status and clear T. HuCC tests A via TAX/BNE or CMP, so these branches do not prove BIOS flags. Actual BIOS N/V/T/B/D/I/Z/C outputs UNKNOWN.

irq.value: HuCC exec_overlay executes CLI before direct CD_READ and waits for its own irq_cnt before overlay loading. This is a caller setup observation; BIOS interrupt-enable prerequisites, IRQ masks and callbacks UNKNOWN.

errors.value: HuCC expects A=0 success and NZ error and reports MPR3 corruption on CD error. Hu-Go reports A=$22 for mode $FF with zero sectors; unsupported modes fall back to original execution rather than define an error. BIOS error taxonomy/zero-count behavior UNKNOWN.

synchronization.value: HuCC consumes status immediately and then proceeds with the destination; Hu-Go models synchronous sector loops. Actual BIOS completion/timing/IRQ interaction UNKNOWN.

arguments.value: HuCC cd_getver(void) supplies no explicit API arguments; system trampoline supplies Y as entry low byte. This does not establish unused registers in the BIOS.

returns.value: cd_getver uses TXA then SAY to convert presumed BIOS X:A into HuCC Y:A; core-stage1 compares X against 3 for a SuperCD version check. Exact System Card 3.0 A value and minor-version encoding UNKNOWN.

clobbered.value: Caller macro overwrites Y, A and instruction flags while converting the result; this is not a callee clobber list. BIOS A/X output expectation is a caller hypothesis.

stack.value: HuCC system macro uses JSR call_bios; trampoline uses JSR candidate entry and RTS with balanced PHA/PLA around bank changes. This is caller source only; callee stack depth, balance and return behavior UNKNOWN.

mpr.value: HuCC caller maps bank 0 into MPR7 for the call and restores caller MPR7 afterward. Startup maps MPR0=$FF and MPR1=$F8. Actual callee mapping prerequisites and preservation UNKNOWN.
